home_subtitle: 第五课 · 交流大直播
part1_desc: 第 1–21 步：快速回顾现在完成时全部要点，补易混点 been/gone，站长带热身。
part2_desc: 第 22–48 步：直播决赛独立闯关，再加时赛：完形填空、阅读理解和跨单元语法混考。
note: 本课阅读材料为教研自编，非课本原文。考查能力：现在完成时综合运用；加时赛首现中考题型（完形填空、阅读理解）与跨单元语法混考（被动语态、比较级最高级）。Unit 5 Educational exchanges 主题。

steps.title: 交流大直播
steps.teach_html:
交流特别节目做到最后一期了。站长说：来一场交流大直播！现场 quiz 问答，把这单元学的全考一遍。

这期不讲新语法，咱们复习：现在完成时、ever/never、just/already/yet、提问回答。

steps.title: 回顾：结构
steps.teach_html:
先回顾结构：have/has + 过去分词。

I have been to Beijing.（我去过北京。）

She has eaten dumplings.（她吃过饺子。）

三单用 has，其余用 have。

steps.title: 回顾：ever/never
steps.teach_html:
ever（曾经）放中间问：Have you ever been there?

never（从不）表否定：I have never been there.

never 本身否定，不再加 not。

steps.title: 回顾：just/already/yet
steps.teach_html:
just（刚刚）、already（已经）放 have 后面：I have just arrived.

yet 放否定句末（还没）：I haven't finished yet；放疑问句末（了吗）：Have you finished yet?

steps.title: 回顾：提问回答
steps.teach_html:
提问：Have/Has + 主语 + ever + 过去分词？

回答：Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.

特殊疑问：Where/What/Who + have/has + 主语 + 过去分词？

steps.title: 回顾：完成时 vs 过去时
steps.teach_html:
最后回顾：说经历用现在完成时（I have been to Beijing）；说具体过去时间用过去时（I went there last year）。

看到 yesterday/last week/in 2020，用过去时。

准备好了吗？直播 quiz 开始！

steps.title: 易混点：been 和 gone
steps.teach_html:
热身前先补一个易混点：been 和 gone 都从 go 变来，意思不一样。

has been to：去过，人已经回来了。He has been to Xi'an.（他去过西安。）

has gone to：去（某地）了，人还没回来。He has gone to Xi'an.（他去西安了，不在这儿。）

说经历用 been，说人不在用 gone。

steps.title: 题库
steps.teach_html:
这是 quiz 题库要点。做题时对照着想：结构、助动词、过去分词、小词位置。

站长带着热身。

steps.title: 直播加时赛：中考题型
steps.teach_html:
决赛结束？还没完——今晚加一场加时赛，用中考的出题方式来。

一是完形填空：读一篇文章，挖空选词，全靠上下文。二是阅读理解：读短文回答问题。中间还有几道混考：以前单元的被动语态、比较级最高级也会出现。

加时赛没有题库对照，全靠自己判断。开始！

steps.title: 挑战 · 完形短文
steps.teach_html:
加时赛第一项：完形填空。先把短文读一遍，知道大概讲什么，再逐个空选。

Tom has just come back from Australia. Last July, he went on a two-week exchange trip there. He has lived with a host family __1__ two weeks, and he has learned a lot. Before the trip, he had never eaten foreign food. One day, his host mother asked, "Have you __2__ tried kangaroo meat?" Tom tried some and liked it. He has __3__ friends with two boys there, and they write to each other every week. He went to a school last Monday and gave a talk about China. "I have kept a diary __4__ the first day," he says.

steps.title: 挑战 · 完形第1空
steps.stem: He has lived with a host family ______ two weeks, and he has learned a lot.
steps.help: 先看空后面跟的是一段时间，还是一段时间点。
steps.explain: for + 一段时间（two weeks），表示持续了多久，选 for。

wrong_feedback.B: since 后面跟时间点（如 2023、last week）；two weeks 是一段时间，要用 for。
wrong_feedback.C: during 后面跟一段时间里的某个时期（如 during the trip），不能直接跟 two weeks 表示时长，这里用 for。
wrong_feedback.D: from 是“从……”，不能单独表示“持续了多久”；持续一段时间用 for。

steps.reading: Tom has just come back from Australia. Last July, he went on a two-week exchange trip there. He has lived with a host family __1__ two weeks, and he has learned a lot. Before the trip, he had never eaten foreign food. One day, his host mother asked, "Have you __2__ tried kangaroo meat?" Tom tried some and liked it. He has __3__ friends with two boys there, and they write to each other every week. He went to a school last Monday and gave a talk about China. "I have kept a diary __4__ the first day," he says.

steps.title: 挑战 · 完形第2空
steps.stem: One day, his host mother asked, 'Have you ______ tried kangaroo meat?'
steps.help: 先想：这句是问经历，还是问做没做完。
steps.explain: 问“曾经……吗”用 ever，放在 have 和过去分词之间。

wrong_feedback.A: never 是“从不”，用在陈述句里表示否定，不能拿来提问经历。
wrong_feedback.B: just 是“刚刚”；这里是问他有过这个经历没有，不问是不是刚刚。
wrong_feedback.D: yet 一般放在疑问句末尾（Have you tried it yet?），不放在 tried 前面提问经历。

steps.reading: Tom has just come back from Australia. Last July, he went on a two-week exchange trip there. He has lived with a host family __1__ two weeks, and he has learned a lot. Before the trip, he had never eaten foreign food. One day, his host mother asked, "Have you __2__ tried kangaroo meat?" Tom tried some and liked it. He has __3__ friends with two boys there, and they write to each other every week. He went to a school last Monday and gave a talk about China. "I have kept a diary __4__ the first day," he says.

steps.title: 挑战 · 完形第3空
steps.stem: He has ______ friends with two boys there, and they write to each other every week.
steps.help: 先看 has 后面跟动词的哪种形式，再想固定搭配。
steps.explain: has 后面要跟过去分词，made；make friends 是“交朋友”。

wrong_feedback.A: make 是原形，has 后面不能跟原形，要用过去分词 made。
wrong_feedback.C: making 是现在分词，has 后面要用过去分词 made。
wrong_feedback.D: makes 是三单现在式，has 后面要用过去分词 made。

steps.reading: Tom has just come back from Australia. Last July, he went on a two-week exchange trip there. He has lived with a host family __1__ two weeks, and he has learned a lot. Before the trip, he had never eaten foreign food. One day, his host mother asked, "Have you __2__ tried kangaroo meat?" Tom tried some and liked it. He has __3__ friends with two boys there, and they write to each other every week. He went to a school last Monday and gave a talk about China. "I have kept a diary __4__ the first day," he says.

steps.title: 挑战 · 完形第4空
steps.stem: 'I have kept a diary ______ the first day,' he says.
steps.help: 先看空后面是时间点还是时间段。
steps.explain: the first day 是一个时间点，“自从那时到现在”用 since。

wrong_feedback.A: for 后面跟一段时间（如 for two weeks）；the first day 是时间点，要用 since。
wrong_feedback.B: from 只说从哪开始，不表示一直持续到现在；“从那时到现在”用 since。
wrong_feedback.C: after 是“在……之后”，只说先后，不表示持续到现在，这里用 since。

Before the trip, he had never eaten foreign food. One day, his host mother asked, "Have you __2__ tried kangaroo meat?" Tom tried some and liked it. He has __3__ friends with two boys there, and they write to each other every week. He went to a school last Monday and gave a talk about China. "I have kept a diary __4__ the first day," he says.

steps.title: 挑战 · 骑过马吗
steps.stem: ______ your grandpa ever ridden a horse?
steps.help: 先数一数：主语是一个，还是多个。
steps.explain: Has your grandpa ever ridden a horse?

wrong_feedback.B: grandpa 是一人（第三人称单数），现在完成时疑问句要用 Has 开头，不用 Have。
wrong_feedback.C: Is 后面跟不了过去分词 ridden 组成完成时；问经历要用 Has。
wrong_feedback.D: Does 后面要跟动词原形 ride，跟不了 ridden；表示经历的疑问句要用 Has。

steps.title: 挑战 · 写出过去分词：begin
steps.scene: 把 begin 变成过去分词。
steps.stem: 写出 begin 的过去分词。
steps.help: begin 的变化是 i、a、u 的顺序：begin、began、begun。
steps.explain: begin → began（过去式）→ begun（过去分词）。

common_errors.say: began 是过去式，过去分词是 begun。
begin 是不规则动词，不能加 ed：began / begun。
beginning 是现在分词（或动名词），过去分词是 begun。

steps.title: 挑战 · 从2012年起
steps.scene: 格林老师从 2012 年起教英语。
steps.help: 先看空后面：2012 是一个时间点，还是一段时间。
steps.explain: since + 时间点（2012），表示从那时一直到现在。

wrong_feedback.A: for 后面要跟一段时间（如 for ten years）；2012 是时间点，要用 since。
wrong_feedback.B: in 2012 是一般过去时里的时间说法，不能跟 has taught 连用表示持续到现在。
wrong_feedback.D: from 只说从哪一年开始，不表示持续到现在；这里要用 since。

steps.title: 挑战 · 大桥建成
steps.task: 写出空里的两个词（be 动词 + 过去分词）。
steps.help: 先想：大桥是自己建起来的，还是被人建的；再看时间是哪一年。

common_errors.say: in 2019 是过去的时间，要用 was built，不用现在时的 is built。
被动语态要用过去分词：build 的过去分词是 built，写 was built。
少了 be 动词。被动语态 = be 动词 + 过去分词：was built。
build 是不规则动词，过去分词是 built，不能加 ed。

steps.title: 挑战 · 茶叶种植
steps.stem: Tea ______ in many parts of China.
steps.help: 先想：茶是自己种自己，还是被人种的。
steps.explain: Tea is grown in many parts of China.

wrong_feedback.A: grows 是主动“生长”；这里说茶被人种植，要用被动 is grown。
wrong_feedback.C: grow 是动词原形，Tea 是单数不能直接用原形；意思上也是被人种，用被动 is grown。
wrong_feedback.D: growing 是现在分词，不能单独作谓语，这里要用被动 is grown。

steps.title: 挑战 · 最美的公园
steps.scene: 三个公园里，中山公园最美。
steps.stem: Of the three parks, Zhongshan Park is ______.
steps.help: 先数一数：一共比了几个。
steps.explain: Of the three parks, Zhongshan Park is the most beautiful.

wrong_feedback.A: beautiful 是原形，不能表示“最美”；三者及以上比较要用最高级。
wrong_feedback.B: more beautiful 是比较级，只能比两者高低；这里一共三个公园，要用最高级。
wrong_feedback.D: 最高级前面要有 the：the most beautiful，不能只写 most beautiful。

steps.title: 挑战 · 阅读短文
steps.teach_html:
加时赛第二项：阅读理解。先读短文，再答后面的题。

Anna is an exchange student from Canada. She has been in Beijing for three months. Before she came to China, she had never used chopsticks. Now she can use them very well. Last Sunday, her Chinese friend Li Hua took her to a famous old street. They visited a small museum there. In the museum, Anna saw many old photos of Beijing. "Beijing has changed a lot," Li Hua said. Anna has taken photos of many places in Beijing, and she has written about them in her diary. She says she has learned more Chinese in three months than in two years in Canada. Next month, she will go back home, but she hopes to come to Beijing again.

steps.title: 挑战 · 阅读1
steps.stem: Anna has been in Beijing for ______ months.
steps.task: 只写那个表示数字的英文单词。
steps.help: 回到短文第一句找一找。
steps.explain: 短文第一句：She has been in Beijing for three months.

common_errors.say: 这里要用英文单词 three，不写阿拉伯数字 3。
two 是她在加拿大两年（two years）；在北京的时间是 three months。

steps.reading: Anna is an exchange student from Canada. She has been in Beijing for three months. Before she came to China, she had never used chopsticks. Now she can use them very well. Last Sunday, her Chinese friend Li Hua took her to a famous old street. They visited a small museum there. In the museum, Anna saw many old photos of Beijing. "Beijing has changed a lot," Li Hua said. Anna has taken photos of many places in Beijing, and she has written about them in her diary. She says she has learned more Chinese in three months than in two years in Canada. Next month, she will go back home, but she hopes to come to Beijing again.

steps.title: 挑战 · 阅读2
steps.scene: 读短文，选可以得出的结论。
steps.stem: From the passage, we can know that ______.
options: Anna had used chopsticks before she came to China
Anna will stay in Beijing for three more months
Li Hua has been to Canada
Anna has learned a lot during her stay in Beijing
steps.help: 把每个选项跟短文对一对，短文里找得到依据的才选。
steps.explain: 短文说她筷子用得很好、三个月学的中文比两年还多，可知她在这段时间学到了很多。

wrong_feedback.A: 短文说她来中国前从没用过筷子（had never used chopsticks），这个选项说反了。
wrong_feedback.B: 短文说她下个月回国（will go back home next month），不是再待三个月。
wrong_feedback.C: 短文没说李华去过加拿大，没提到的内容不能选。

steps.reading: Anna is an exchange student from Canada. She has been in Beijing for three months. Before she came to China, she had never used chopsticks. Now she can use them very well. Last Sunday, her Chinese friend Li Hua took her to a famous old street. They visited a small museum there. In the museum, Anna saw many old photos of Beijing. "Beijing has changed a lot," Li Hua said. Anna has taken photos of many places in Beijing, and she has written about them in her diary. She says she has learned more Chinese in three months than in two years in Canada. Next month, she will go back home, but she hopes to come to Beijing again.

steps.title: 挑战 · 阅读3
steps.scene: 给短文选一个最合适的标题。
steps.stem: What is the best title for the passage?
options: A Famous Old Street in Beijing
steps.help: 想一想：短文从头到尾都在讲谁、讲什么事。
steps.explain: 短文讲的都是安娜在北京交换生活的经历，C 最全面。

wrong_feedback.A: 用筷子只是短文里的一个小细节，不能当全文标题。
wrong_feedback.B: 老街只是他们去的一个地方，只占一小段，不是全文重点。
wrong_feedback.D: 老照片只在博物馆那一段出现，用一小段概括全文，以偏概全了。

steps.reading: Anna is an exchange student from Canada. She has been in Beijing for three months. Before she came to China, she had never used chopsticks. Now she can use them very well. Last Sunday, her Chinese friend Li Hua took her to a famous old street. They visited a small museum there. In the museum, Anna saw many old photos of Beijing. "Beijing has changed a lot," Li Hua said. Anna has taken photos of many places in Beijing, and she has written about them in her diary. She says she has learned more Chinese in three months than in two years in Canada. Next month, she will go back home, but she hopes to come to Beijing again.

steps.title: 直播结束
steps.teach_html:
直播到这里就结束啦，Unit 5 的现在完成时全部复习完了。

今天你还第一次做了中考的题型：完形填空和阅读理解。这样的题以后还会再见。
